abilities.name: Barbed Sling
abilities.description: A slung fistful of barbs. Steady poke while the garden grows.

abilities.name: Snare Bloom
abilities.description: Plants a hidden snare. Triggers on entry in any phase: 12 damage and Root for a turn. A rooted victim loses their Move — and stands in Barbed Sling range.

abilities.name: Bramble Stride
abilities.description: Thorn surges through the undergrowth up to 3 squares; the first unit crossed takes 10 damage and is Rooted for a turn. The escape that still leaves someone stuck to the floor.

abilities.name: Verdant Veil
abilities.description: Restorative spores heal allies in the aimed area for 20. Smaller than a Mender's heal — Thorn's defense budget is partly spent on control.

ultimate.name: Overgrowth
ultimate.description: The ground erupts: allies in the area heal 30; enemies are Rooted and Weakened for a turn. The board itself takes a side. (100 energy)
